meta.description: Authored 1900 sample of eight polities for M5 multi-region, multi-market, migration, and labor-mobility validation, with the provisional M5a profit-allocation policy and M6 country-AI policy enabled. Population totals are rounded national estimates; occupation composition, market membership, building levels, needs, recipe productivity, prices, wages, profit-allocation rates, and AI fiscal rules are provisional authored inputs. The post-M7 feasibility calibration makes each market's subsistence/basic capacity meet its own demand and sets opening prices at the documented lower provisional bound; it is not historical calibration. This is not a complete historical reconstruction and its eight polities are not a world total.

sources.title: Our World in Data — Population, long-run series
sources.notes: Round national population estimates for 1900. The campaign sample covers eight polities only; it is not a world total and does not reconcile to the M2 world aggregate.

sources.title: Maddison Project Database 2023
sources.notes: Long-run population and income reconstructions used as cross-checks for rounded 1900 national totals.

sources.title: Our World in Data — Employment by sector (historical reconstructions)
sources.notes: Broad 1900 agricultural-employment reconstructions used only to set wide provisional occupation-structure ranges, not as measured observations.

sources.title: Century M2 provisional 1900 world age structure
sources.notes: Provisional 1900 world age/sex profile used to expand each historical block total. It is not a country-specific age observation.

sources.title: Century M5 authored sample tables and source notes
sources.notes: Authored region boundaries, market membership, fiscal settings, building levels, and structure allocations. Explicitly provisional.

world-1900-provisional.notes: World 1900 five-year profile reused for every country. Country-specific age structures are not implemented and would be required for historical age-structure validation.
